<!-- T123 · Revolut — One Market First · block 3 of 3: game interface · generated by node scripts/build.mjs -->
<script>
(async () => {
"use strict";

const shared = window.__omfModules || {};
if (!shared.hash || !shared.tuning || !shared.scenario || !shared.rules || !shared.progress || !shared.clock || !shared.storage || !shared.sync) {
  const notice = document.querySelector('#one-market-first [data-ui="notice"]');
  if (notice) {
    notice.textContent = "A game block is missing. Paste the three blocks in order: 1 HTML, styles and data, 2 game engine, 3 game interface.";
    notice.hidden = false;
  }
  return;
}
const __omf_hash = shared.hash;
const __omf_tuning = shared.tuning;
const __omf_scenario = shared.scenario;
const __omf_rules = shared.rules;
const __omf_progress = shared.progress;
const __omf_clock = shared.clock;
const __omf_storage = shared.storage;
const __omf_sync = shared.sync;

// src/presentation.mjs
const __omf_presentation = (() => {
const { MARKETS, ROUNDS, WORKSHEET, CONFIG, QUESTION } = __omf_scenario;
const { OUTCOMES, TEAMS, replay, roomStart, marketForTable, scoreExpert, standings } = __omf_rules;
const { tuning } = __omf_tuning;
function esc(value) {
  return String(value ?? "").replaceAll("&", "&amp;").replaceAll("<", "&lt;")
    .replaceAll(">", "&gt;").replaceAll('"', "&quot;").replaceAll("'", "&#39;");
}

function button(label, action, kind = "", attributes = "") {
  return '<button type="button" class="pv-button' + (kind ? ' pv-button--' + kind : '') +
    '" data-action="' + action + '" ' + attributes + '>' + esc(label) + '</button>';
}

function disclosure(label, body, open = false) {
  return '<details class="pv-summary"' + (open ? " open" : "") + '><summary>' + esc(label) +
    '</summary><div class="pv-detail-body">' + body + '</div></details>';
}

function facts(pairs, className = "pv-facts") {
  return '<dl class="' + className + '">' + pairs.map(([label, value]) =>
    '<div><dt>' + esc(label) + '</dt><dd>' + esc(value) + '</dd></div>').join("") + '</dl>';
}

function stage(title, label, body, tone = "") {
  return '<section class="pv-stage" aria-labelledby="omf-stage-title"><header class="pv-stage-head' +
    (tone ? ' pv-stage-head--' + tone : '') + '"><p class="pv-mono">' + esc(label) +
    '</p><h2 id="omf-stage-title" tabindex="-1">' + esc(title) +
    '</h2></header><div class="pv-stage-body">' + body + '</div></section>';
}

function saveFile(filename, data, mime) {
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([data], {type: mime}));
  const link = document.createElement("a");
  link.href = url;
  link.download = filename;
  document.body.append(link);
  link.click();
  link.remove();
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
}

const moscowClock = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", {timeZone: "Europe/Moscow", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", hourCycle: "h23"});

function interval(room, start, end) {
  const base = roomStart(room);
  return moscowClock.format(base + start * 60_000) + "–" + moscowClock.format(base + end * 60_000);
}

function countdown(delta) {
  const seconds = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(delta / 1000));
  const pad = value => String(value).padStart(2, "0");
  const hours = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
  const rest = seconds % 3600;
  const minutes = pad(Math.floor(rest / 60)) + ":" + pad(rest % 60);
  return hours ? hours + ":" + minutes : minutes;
}

function textReport(record, boardOnly = false) {
  const {state, path} = replay(record);
  const market = MARKETS[record.market];
  const profile = market.profiles[state.profile];
  const lines = [
    boardOnly ? "REVOLUT · BOARD BRIEF" : "REVOLUT · TEAM DECISION JOURNAL",
    "Table " + record.team + " · " + market.name + " · " + record.room,
    "Customer: " + (profile?.name || "Pending"),
    "Credits spent: " + (CONFIG.budget - state.credits) + " · remaining: " + state.credits
  ];
  if (path.length === ROUNDS.length) lines.push("Funding request: " + OUTCOMES[path.at(-1).choice][0]);
  if (record.brief) lines.push("", record.brief);
  if (!boardOnly) {
    for (const event of path) {
      lines.push("", event.round + " " + event.label + " · cost " + event.cost + " · balance " + event.credits + " · " + event.method);
      if (event.evidence) lines.push("Evidence: " + event.evidence);
      if (event.tradeoff) lines.push("Trade-off: " + event.tradeoff);
      if (event.result) lines.push("Result: " + event.result);
      for (const [field, label] of WORKSHEET[event.round]) {
        const value = record.notes[event.round + "." + field];
        if (value) lines.push(label + ": " + value);
      }
    }
  } else {
    if (!record.brief) lines.push("", "Team worksheet highlights:");
    const fields = [["R1.cage", "CAGE"], ["R3.later", "Next commitment"], ["R6.approval", "Reopening condition"], ["R7.board", "Board request"]];
    for (const [key, label] of fields) {
      if (!record.brief && record.notes[key]) lines.push(label + ": " + record.notes[key]);
    }
    lines.push("", "For the hearing: " + QUESTION);
  }
  return lines.join("\n");
}

function teamFilename(record, extension, name = "journal") {
  return "revolut-" + record.room.toLowerCase() + "-table-" + record.team + "-" + record.market + "-" + name + "." + extension;
}

// RFC 4180: quote a cell that contains the separator, a quote or a line break, and double inner quotes.
function csvCell(value, separator = ",") {
  const text = String(value ?? "");
  const quote = text.includes('"') || text.includes(separator) || /[\r\n]/.test(text) || text !== text.trim();
  return quote ? '"' + text.replaceAll('"', '""') + '"' : text;
}

// The score table as CSV. `records` are the imported team JSON files: the game result comes from them.
// `russianExcel` writes ";" separators and decimal commas, which is what Excel with Russian regional
// settings expects. A BOM makes Excel read the file as UTF-8.
function scoresCsv(room, gradesByTeam, {russianExcel = false, records = {}} = {}) {
  const separator = russianExcel ? ";" : ",";
  const number = value => (russianExcel ? value.toFixed(1).replace(".", ",") : value.toFixed(1));
  const counted = tuning().gameShare > 0;
  const header = ["rank", "table", "market", "written_70", "oral_30", "uppsala_16"]
    .concat(counted ? ["expert_total_100", "game_100", "final_100"] : ["total_100"], ["expert1_total", "expert2_total", "expert3_total", "status"]);
  const lines = [header].concat(standings(gradesByTeam, records).map(row => {
    const grades = Array.isArray(gradesByTeam?.[row.team]) ? gradesByTeam[row.team] : [];
    const experts = [0, 1, 2].map(expert => grades[expert]?.complete ? number(scoreExpert(grades[expert]).total) : "");
    const done = [0, 1, 2].filter(expert => grades[expert]?.complete).length;
    const status = row.key ? (row.tied ? "tied: the Chair decides" : "complete") :
      row.jury ? "pending: import the team JSON for the game result" : "pending: " + done + " of 3 expert sheets complete";
    const jury = row.jury ? [row.jury.written, row.jury.oral, row.jury.uppsala].map(number) : ["", "", ""];
    const totals = counted ? [row.jury ? number(row.jury.total) : "", row.game === null ? "" : number(row.game), row.final === null ? "" : number(row.final)] :
      [row.jury ? number(row.jury.total) : ""];
    return [row.rank ?? "", row.team, MARKETS[marketForTable(room, row.team)].name].concat(jury, totals, experts, [status]);
  }));
  return "\ufeff" + lines.map(line => line.map(cell => csvCell(cell, separator)).join(separator)).join("\r\n") + "\r\n";
}
return { esc, button, disclosure, facts, stage, saveFile, interval, countdown, textReport, teamFilename, csvCell, scoresCsv };
})();

// src/host.mjs
const __omf_host = (() => {
const { CONFIG, MARKETS, BULLETINS, RUBRIC, QUESTION } = __omf_scenario;
const { TEAMS, SCHEDULE, makeRoom, roomStart, marketForTable, phaseAt, validateRecord, standings, compareScores, hostChecklist } = __omf_rules;
const { tuning } = __omf_tuning;
const { hostKey, getStored, putStored } = __omf_storage;
const { esc, button, disclosure, facts, stage, saveFile, interval, countdown, textReport, scoresCsv } = __omf_presentation;
const { trueNow } = __omf_clock;
const activeKey = hostKey("active");
const moscowDate = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("sv-SE", {timeZone: "Europe/Moscow", year: "numeric", month: "2-digit", day: "2-digit"});
function freshPanel() {
  return {records: {}, grades: {}, joined: false};
}

const host = {room: "", start: "", selected: 1, panel: freshPanel()};
try {
  const room = getStored(activeKey);
  if (roomStart(room) !== null) {
    host.room = room;
    const panel = JSON.parse(getStored(hostKey(room)));
    if (panel) host.panel = panel;
  }
} catch {
  host.panel = freshPanel();
}

function storePanel() {
  putStored(activeKey, host.room);
  putStored(hostKey(host.room), JSON.stringify(host.panel));
}

function startForm() {
  const today = moscowDate.format(new Date());
  const planned = Date.parse(today + "T18:30+03:00");
  const date = moscowDate.format(new Date(planned > trueNow() ? planned : planned + 86_400_000));
  const time = host.start || (host.room ? moscowDate.format(roomStart(host.room)) + "T" + interval(host.room, 0, 1).slice(0, 5) : date + "T18:30");
  return `<div class="pv-panel">
    <label class="pv-field">R1 start · Moscow time
      <input class="pv-input" type="datetime-local" data-host="start" value="${esc(time)}">
    </label><p class="pv-inline-note pv-block-gap">The opening starts 20 minutes before R1. A room sets the timetable and draws four unique markets.</p>
    <div class="pv-actions pv-file-actions">${button("Create a new room", "host-create", "primary")}</div>
  </div>`;
}

function activeRoom() {
  const assignments = TEAMS.map(team => {
    const market = MARKETS[marketForTable(host.room, team)];
    return "<div class=\"pv-panel\"><span class=\"pv-mono\">Table " + team + "</span><strong>" + esc(market.name) +
      "</strong><small>" + esc(market.city) + "</small></div>";
  }).join("");
  return `<div class="pv-record pv-checkpoint"><p class="pv-mono">Room code</p><h3>${esc(host.room)}</h3>
    <p>Show this code and the table assignment. Each team joins with one device and its own table number.</p></div>
    <div class="pv-host-assignments">${assignments}</div>
    <div class="pv-panel pv-block-gap">
      <div class="pv-clock" data-host-clock><span data-host-phase></span><strong data-host-time></strong></div>
      <p data-host-cue class="pv-block-gap"></p>
    </div>`;
}

let checklistPhase = null;

function checklistHtml(now) {
  const {phase, steps, next} = hostChecklist({room: host.room, now, grades: host.panel.grades, records: host.panel.records, joined: host.panel.joined});
  checklistPhase = phase.id;
  const marks = {done: "✔", now: "●", later: "○"};
  const extras = {
    joined: '<label class="pv-check-line"><input type="checkbox" data-host="joined"' + (host.panel.joined ? " checked" : "") + "> All four tables are in</label>",
    game: '<p class="pv-inline-note" data-host-progress></p>',
    files: button("Import team JSON", "import", "", 'data-purpose="host"'),
    ranking: button("Export scores CSV", "host-scores")
  };
  const items = steps.map((step, index) => `<li data-state="${step.state}"><span class="pv-step-mark" aria-hidden="true">${marks[step.state]}</span>
    <div><strong>${index + 1}. ${esc(step.title)}</strong>${step.state === "now" ? ' <span class="pv-mono">now</span>' : ""}<p>${esc(step.detail)}</p>${step.state === "done" && !["game", "joined"].includes(step.id) ? "" : extras[step.id] ?? ""}</div></li>`).join("");
  return `<div class="pv-panel pv-checklist" data-host-checklist><h3>What’s next</h3>
    <p class="pv-next"><strong>${esc(next)}</strong></p><ol class="pv-steps">${items}</ol></div>`;
}

function refreshChecklist() {
  const box = document.querySelector("#one-market-first [data-host-checklist]");
  if (box && host.room) box.outerHTML = checklistHtml(trueNow());
}

function scoresTable() {
  const rows = standings(host.panel.grades, host.panel.records);
  const counted = tuning().gameShare > 0;
  const complete = rows.every(row => row.key);
  const ranked = rows.filter(row => row.key).sort((a, b) => compareScores(a.key, b.key));
  const tied = complete ? ranked.filter(row => compareScores(row.key, ranked[0].key) === 0) : [];
  const heading = !complete ? (counted ? "Complete all three expert sheets and import the team JSON for every table to rank the proposals." :
      "Complete all three expert sheets for every table to rank the proposals.") :
    tied.length > 1 ? "The Chair decides between tables " + tied.map(row => row.team).join(", ") + " and gives a rubric-based reason." :
      "First launch priority · Table " + ranked[0].team + " · " + MARKETS[marketForTable(host.room, ranked[0].team)].name;
  const number = value => (value === null || value === undefined ? "Pending" : value.toFixed(1));
  const body = (complete ? ranked : rows).map(row => "<tr><td>" + esc(MARKETS[marketForTable(host.room, row.team)].name) + "</td>" +
    [row.jury?.written, row.jury?.oral].map(value => "<td>" + number(value) + "</td>").join("") +
    (counted ? "<td>" + number(row.game) + "</td><td>" + number(row.final) + "</td>" : "<td>" + number(row.jury?.total) + "</td>") + "</tr>").join("");
  return `<div class="pv-panel">
    <h3>Board ranking</h3><p>${esc(heading)}</p>
    ${counted ? '<p class="pv-inline-note">Final = ' + Math.round((1 - tuning().gameShare) * 100) + "% experts + " + Math.round(tuning().gameShare * 100) + "% game result. The game result comes from the imported team JSON.</p>" : ""}
    <table class="pv-scores"><thead><tr><th scope="col">Market</th><th scope="col">Written</th><th scope="col">Oral</th>${counted ? '<th scope="col">Game</th><th scope="col">Final</th>' : '<th scope="col">Total</th>'}</tr></thead>
    <tbody>${body}</tbody></table>
    <div class="pv-actions pv-file-actions">${button("Export scores CSV", "host-scores")}${button("Export for Excel", "host-scores-ru")}</div></div>`;
}

function judgeTable(team) {
  const imported = host.panel.records[team];
  const data = host.panel.grades[team] || [];
  const sheets = [0, 1, 2].map(expert => {
    const grade = data[expert] || {checks: [], complete: false};
    return disclosure("Expert " + (expert + 1) + " · " + (grade.complete ? "complete" : "draft"),
      RUBRIC.map(([section, name, points, criteria], row) => `<fieldset class="pv-panel">
        <legend>${esc(section + " · " + name + " · " + points / 4 + " per check")}</legend><div class="pv-checks">
        ${criteria.map((item, index) => `<label><input type="checkbox" data-host="check" data-expert="${expert}" data-row="${row}" data-check="${index}"
          ${grade.checks[row]?.[index] ? "checked" : ""}> ${esc(item)}</label>`).join("")}
        </div></fieldset>`).join("") +
      '<label class="pv-panel pv-field"><span><input type="checkbox" data-host="complete" data-expert="' + expert + '"' +
      (grade.complete ? " checked" : "") + '> This expert sheet is complete</span></label>');
  }).join("");
  const teamOptions = TEAMS.map(value => '<option value="' + value + '"' + (team === value ? " selected" : "") + ">Table " + value +
    " · " + esc(MARKETS[marketForTable(host.room, value)].name) + "</option>").join("");
  return `<div class="pv-panel">
    <h3>Strategy and hearing score sheets</h3>
    <p>Collect the team JSON after R7. Review written checks during the game and preparation. Score the pitch and common answer separately. Three experts submit their four independent checks for each criterion.</p>
    <label class="pv-field pv-block-gap">Review table<select class="pv-input" data-host="selected">${teamOptions}</select></label>
    <div class="pv-actions pv-file-actions">${button("Import team JSON", "import", "", 'data-purpose="host"')}</div>
    ${imported ? disclosure("Imported team journal · " + imported.history.length + "/7 decisions", '<p class="pv-worksheet-note">' + esc(textReport(imported)) + "</p>") : ""}
    ${sheets}
  </div>`;
}

function guide(room) {
  const schedule = SCHEDULE.map(item =>
    ["<li><strong>", esc(interval(room, item.from, item.to)), "</strong><span>", esc(item.label), "</span></li>"].join("")).join("");
  return disclosure("Facilitator script and timetable", `
    <div class="pv-wording">
      <h3>20 minutes before R1</h3>
      <p>Make four mixed tables. If the roster includes exchange students, privately distribute them as evenly as possible. Keep the tables balanced and run the case in English. Give the group its table number and read the Board brief without assigning student positions.</p>
      <p>Explain credits with a sample. With 5 practice credits, buying an interview for 2 leaves 3, so a response costing 4 is unavailable. Every real team starts with 9.</p>
      <p>Explain the deadline. A complete, affordable browser draft locks when time runs out. The free default is applied if any required draft field is missing. Keep printed round cards and one blank ledger per team for an offline fallback.</p>
      ${facts([["Expert 1","Open the session, project the clock, warn with two minutes left and time each pitch."],
        ["Expert 2","Support the team devices, check budgets and keep the R4 checkpoints."],
        ["Expert 3","Read both crisis bulletins and gather journals, score sheets and Board Briefs."],
        ["Board Chair","Give the assignment, ask the same question in each hearing and announce the decision."]])}
      <ul class="pv-schedule">${schedule}</ul>
      <h3>Board hearing</h3>
      <p>Draw the order before preparation. Each team gets three minutes and one minute for this question. “${esc(QUESTION)}”</p>
      <p>Announce the market, the preparation or implementation step funded now, and the condition for live activity. Break a total-score tie by oral score, then Uppsala score. The Chair decides any remaining tie and explains the reason.</p>
    </div>`);
}

function renderHost(now = trueNow()) {
  return stage("Facilitator dashboard", "Seminar operations",
    (host.room ? activeRoom() + checklistHtml(now) + guide(host.room) + '<div class="pv-block-gap">' + scoresTable() + judgeTable(host.selected) + "</div>" : "") +
    '<div class="pv-block-gap">' + (host.room ? disclosure("Set up another room", startForm()) : startForm()) + "</div>", "review");
}

function hostClock(root, now) {
  const clock = root.querySelector("[data-host-clock]");
  if (!clock || !host.room) return;
  const phase = phaseAt(host.room, now);
  const bulletin = phase.id === "R6" && !phase.bulletinB;
  const delta = phase.to === null ? null : roomStart(host.room) + (bulletin ? 92 : phase.to) * 60_000 - now;
  const cue = {
    SETUP: "Create mixed tables, explain the mandate and run the practice example.",
    R1: "Release the Singapore baseline and assigned market. Remind teams to build their own CAGE.",
    R2: "The selected profile gets a customer signal and a choice of evidence packages.",
    R3: "Release local candidate files and ask for learning and commitment thresholds.",
    R4: "Explain what the scoped review buys. Save a JSON checkpoint before the break.",
    R5: "Each profile receives a different rival move. Ask how the team now competes.",
    R7: "Each team chooses what to fund and states the condition for its next commitment.",
    BREAK: "Export the checkpoint, then reopen the same room and table at the next seminar.",
    R6: bulletin ? BULLETINS.A : BULLETINS.B + " Each team sees its customer-specific note.",
    PREP: "Collect team JSON or written logs, finish the written checks and give teams the pitch order.",
    PITCH: "One four-minute slot per team. " + QUESTION,
    DEBRIEF: "Reconcile all scores. Announce the selected next investment and its live-launch condition.",
    END: "Session complete. Export the ranking and keep the team journals."
  }[phase.id] || phase.label;
  clock.dataset.near = delta !== null && delta <= 120_000;
  clock.querySelector("[data-host-phase]").textContent = phase.label || phase.id;
  clock.querySelector("[data-host-time]").textContent = delta === null ? "—" : countdown(delta);
  root.querySelector("[data-host-cue]").textContent = cue;

  // The checklist follows the clock: restate it when the phase changes, and keep its progress line live.
  if (phase.id !== checklistPhase) {
    const box = root.querySelector("[data-host-checklist]");
    if (box) box.outerHTML = checklistHtml(now);
  }
  const progress = root.querySelector("[data-host-progress]");
  if (progress) {
    progress.textContent = phase.id === "SETUP" ? "R1 opens at " + interval(host.room, 0, 1).slice(0, 5) + " Moscow time, in " + (delta === null ? "—" : countdown(delta)) :
      delta === null ? "The seminar is over." : phase.label + " · " + countdown(delta) + " left in this part";
  }
}

function exportScores(russianExcel = false) {
  saveFile("revolut-" + host.room.toLowerCase() + "-scores" + (russianExcel ? "-excel-ru" : "") + ".csv",
    scoresCsv(host.room, host.panel.grades, {russianExcel, records: host.panel.records}), "text/csv;charset=utf-8");
}

async function handleHostAction(id, target, ui) {
  if (id === "host-create") {
    const start = target.closest(".pv-panel").querySelector('[data-host="start"]').value;
    const instant = Date.parse(start + "+03:00");
    if (!start || !Number.isFinite(instant)) throw new Error("Set a valid R1 start in Moscow time.");
    const random = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint32Array(2));
    const next = makeRoom(instant, random[0] % 24, (random[1] % 46656).toString(36).padStart(3, "0"));
    if (roomStart(next) === null) throw new Error("Select a date between 2025 and 2099.");
    if (host.room && !await ui.ask("Switch to a new room?", "The current room’s exports can still be kept. The dashboard will open the new room.", "Create room")) return;
    host.room = next;
    host.start = start;
    host.selected = 1;
    host.panel = freshPanel();
    storePanel();
    ui.announce("Room created. Show the room code and table numbers to participants.");
    ui.render("#omf-stage-title");
  } else if (id === "host-scores") exportScores();
  else if (id === "host-scores-ru") exportScores(true);
}

function updateHostField(input, render) {
  const {host: field} = input.dataset;
  if (field === "start") {
    host.start = input.value;
    return;
  }
  if (!host.room || !render) return;
  if (field === "selected") {
    host.selected = Number(input.value);
    render();
    return;
  }
  if (field === "joined") {
    host.panel.joined = input.checked;
    storePanel();
    refreshChecklist();
    return;
  }
  if (field !== "check" && field !== "complete") return;
  const team = host.selected;
  const expert = Number(input.dataset.expert);
  const grades = host.panel.grades[team] || [{checks: []}, {checks: []}, {checks: []}];
  const grade = grades[expert];
  if (field === "complete") grade.complete = input.checked;
  else {
    const row = Number(input.dataset.row);
    grade.checks[row] ||= [];
    grade.checks[row][Number(input.dataset.check)] = input.checked;
    grade.complete = false;
    input.closest("details").querySelector('[data-host="complete"]').checked = false;
  }
  input.closest("details").querySelector("summary").textContent = "Expert " + (expert + 1) + " · " + (grade.complete ? "complete" : "draft");
  host.panel.grades[team] = grades;
  storePanel();
  const previous = input.closest(".pv-stage-body").querySelector(".pv-scores").closest(".pv-panel");
  previous.outerHTML = scoresTable();
  refreshChecklist();
}

async function importTeamFile(file, ui) {
  if (!host.room) throw new Error("Create a room first.");
  if (file.size > CONFIG.maxImportBytes) throw new Error("The JSON file is too large.");
  let parsed;
  try { parsed = JSON.parse(await file.text()); }
  catch { throw new Error("Choose a JSON file exported by the game."); }
  const record = validateRecord(parsed);
  if (record.room !== host.room) throw new Error("This team file belongs to another room.");
  const current = host.panel.records[record.team];
  if (current && !await ui.ask("Replace the imported journal?", "Import the selected file for table " + record.team + "?", "Import")) return;
  host.panel.records[record.team] = record;
  host.selected = record.team;
  storePanel();
  ui.announce("Imported table " + record.team + " with " + record.history.length + "/7 locked decisions.");
  ui.render();
}
return { renderHost, hostClock, handleHostAction, updateHostField, importTeamFile };
})();

// src/app.mjs
await (async () => {
const { CONFIG, SOURCES, SINGAPORE, MARKETS, BRIEF, ROUNDS, BULLETINS, WORKSHEET, RUBRIC, QUESTION, PROBLEMS } = __omf_scenario;
const { TEAMS, SCHEDULE, OUTCOMES, makeRoom, marketForTable, roomStart, phaseAt, replay, optionsFor, pendingFact, settleDeadlines, lockRound, updateDraft, updateNote, updateBrief, canReadBulletinB, isDraftComplete, validateRecord, contentMismatch, gameScore } = __omf_rules;
const { storageAvailable, getStored, teamKey, readSlot, storeRecord, clearSlot, activeTeam, newId, newRecord, withSaveLock, knownTable, SaveError, recoveryOptions, requestPersistence, persistenceState, readBackup, markBackup, backupBehind } = __omf_storage;
const { esc, button, disclosure, facts, stage, saveFile, interval, countdown, textReport, teamFilename } = __omf_presentation;
const { renderHost, handleHostAction, updateHostField, importTeamFile, hostClock } = __omf_host;
const { trueNow, clockStatus, syncClock } = __omf_clock;
const { gameProgress } = __omf_progress;
const { tuning } = __omf_tuning;
const { configureSync, flushSync, syncSummary } = __omf_sync;
const root = document.querySelector("#one-market-first");
const ui = Object.fromEntries([...root.querySelectorAll("[data-ui]")].map(element => [element.dataset.ui, element]));
const view = {
  page: "home", entryMode: "live", room: "", team: 1, market: "indonesia", record: null,
  pageKey: "", recovery: null, practiceReview: null, notice: "", readingFor: "team", busy: false, writes: Promise.resolve()
};
configureSync(root.dataset.syncUrl);
const marketList = Object.entries(MARKETS);
const scheduledRoom = makeRoom(Date.UTC(2026, 0, 1, 15, 30), 0, "000");

function announce(message, tone = "info") {
  view.notice = message;
  ui.notice.dataset.tone = tone;
  renderNotice();
}

function clockNote() {
  const status = clockStatus();
  if (status.synced) {
    const seconds = Math.round(Math.abs(status.offset) / 1000);
    return seconds < 2 ? "" : " This device’s clock is " + seconds + " s " + (status.offset > 0 ? "slow" : "fast") + ". The game follows the server time.";
  }
  const live = view.page === "host" || view.record?.mode === "live";
  return live ? " Server time is unavailable, so this device’s clock sets the rounds. Compare it with the facilitator’s clock." : "";
}

function renderNotice() {
  const warning = storageAvailable() ? "" : " Browser storage is unavailable. Export the JSON before leaving this page.";
  ui.notice.textContent = (view.notice + warning + clockNote()).trim();
  ui.notice.hidden = !ui.notice.textContent;
}

function sourceLinks(ids) {
  return "<ul>" + ids.map(id => SOURCES[id]).map(([label, url]) =>
    '<li><a href="' + esc(url) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">' + esc(label) + "</a></li>").join("") + "</ul>";
}

function teamSelector() {
  return '<label class="pv-field">Assigned table<select class="pv-input" data-entry="team">' +
    TEAMS.map(team => '<option value="' + team + '"' + (view.team === team ? " selected" : "") + ">Table " + team + "</option>").join("") +
    "</select></label>";
}

function homeScreen() {
  const room = view.room.toUpperCase().trim();
  const assigned = roomStart(room) === null ? null : MARKETS[marketForTable(room, view.team)];
  return `<section class="pv-hero" aria-labelledby="omf-title">
    <div class="pv-hero-grid"><div class="pv-hero-text">
      <span class="pv-kicker pv-mono">Revolut APAC case</span>
      <h1 id="omf-title" tabindex="-1"><span>One Market</span><span>First</span></h1>
      <p>Four consulting teams. One expansion mandate. Make the case for funding your market first.</p>
      ${button("Join your table", "jump-entry", "primary")}
    </div><div class="pv-hero-art" aria-hidden="true">
      <span class="pv-art-code pv-art-code--top pv-mono">APAC · Market entry</span>
      <svg viewBox="0 0 580 350" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice" fill="none">
            <defs>
              <pattern id="pv-graph" width="29" height="29" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">

              </pattern>
              <pattern id="pv-raster" width="6" height="6" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
                <circle cx="2" cy="2" r="1" fill="var(--pv-ink)" fill-opacity=".6"/>
              </pattern>
            </defs>
            <rect width="580" height="350" fill="url(#pv-graph)"/>

            <circle cx="302" cy="178" r="111" stroke="var(--pv-ink)" stroke-width="1.4"/>

            <path d="M218 82v191h151V82H218Z" fill="var(--pv-ink)" stroke="var(--pv-ink)" stroke-width="2.5"/>
            <path d="M234 68h149v191H234z" fill="var(--pv-white)" stroke="var(--pv-ink)" stroke-width="2.5"/>
            <path d="M251 84h115v175H251z" fill="var(--pv-blue)" stroke="var(--pv-ink)" stroke-width="2.5"/>
            <path d="m366 259-89 30V102l89-18v175Z" fill="var(--pv-lime)" stroke="var(--pv-ink)" stroke-width="2.5"/>
            <circle cx="348" cy="177" r="5.5" fill="var(--pv-ink)"/>
            <path d="M309 228h131m-21-20 21 20-21 20" stroke="var(--pv-ink)" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="square"/>
            <path d="M309 223h131m-21-20 21 20-21 20" stroke="var(--pv-orange)" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="square"/>
            <path d="m449 55 9 29 27-13-14 27 29 10-30 10 14 27-26-13-10 28-9-29-27 13 14-27-29-10 29-9-13-27 27 13 9-29Z" fill="var(--pv-orange)" stroke="var(--pv-ink)" stroke-width="2.3"/>
            <g transform="translate(96 218) rotate(-13)">
              <rect x="0" y="0" width="109" height="58" fill="var(--pv-lime)" stroke="var(--pv-ink)" stroke-width="2.2"/>
              <path d="M11 12h87v33H11z" stroke="var(--pv-ink)" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="3 2"/>
              <text x="54.5" y="33" text-anchor="middle" fill="var(--pv-ink)" font-family="Arial,sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="800">ENTER ↗</text>
            </g>
            <path d="M101 123h37m-18-18v37M472 270h28m-14-14v28" stroke="var(--pv-white)" stroke-width="1.4"/>
            <path d="M498 44v25m6-25v25m6-25v25m8-25v25m3-25v25m8-25v25m6-25v25" stroke="var(--pv-white)" stroke-width="1.2"/>
          </svg>
    </div></div>
    <div class="pv-tape pv-mono"><span><b>04</b><small>Markets</small></span><span><b>${String(CONFIG.budget).padStart(2, "0")}</b><small>Credits per team</small></span><span><b>01</b><small>Funding mandate</small></span></div>
  </section>
  <section class="pv-entry" aria-labelledby="omf-entry-title">
    <div class="pv-section-head"><h2 id="omf-entry-title" tabindex="-1">${view.entryMode === "live" ? "Join the classroom" : "Practice without a room"}</h2></div>
    <div class="pv-entry-panel">
      <form data-form="join">
        <div class="pv-entry-fields">
          ${view.entryMode === "live" ? `<label class="pv-field">Room code<input class="pv-input" name="room" data-entry="room" value="${esc(view.room)}" autocapitalize="characters" autocomplete="off" maxlength="23" placeholder="OMF-…"></label>
          ${teamSelector()}` : `<label class="pv-field">Practice market<select class="pv-input" data-entry="market">${marketList.map(([id, market]) =>
            `<option value="${id}"${view.market === id ? " selected" : ""}>${market.name}</option>`).join("")}</select></label>${teamSelector()}`}
        </div>
        <p class="pv-inline-note pv-block-gap" data-assigned>${assigned && view.entryMode === "live" ? "Your assigned market is " + esc(assigned.name) + "." : "Use the table number assigned by the facilitator."}</p>
        <div class="pv-entry-foot"><div class="pv-actions">
          <button type="submit" class="pv-button pv-button--primary">${view.entryMode === "live" ? "Open team dashboard" : "Open practice dashboard"}</button>
          ${button("Restore JSON", "import", "", 'data-purpose="team"')}
          ${button(view.entryMode === "live" ? "Practice without a room" : "Back to classroom", "entry-mode", "text")}
        </div></div>
      </form>
    </div>
  </section>`;
}

function renderMaterials() {
  ui["materials-body"].innerHTML = `
    <div class="pv-wording"><h3>Board brief</h3>${BRIEF.map(line => "<p>" + esc(line) + "</p>").join("")}</div>
    ${disclosure("How to play", '<ol class="pv-guidance">' + [
      "Sit at the assigned table. Make decisions together in English. Everyone can speak and there are no fixed positions.",
      "Read the new card. Compare the options and prices against your remaining credits.",
      "Select an action and write a short evidence note and trade-off. A complete, eligible draft saved before the deadline locks at the deadline if you have not locked it already. Otherwise the free default applies.",
      "You may edit worksheet notes during the active round, even after locking the choice. New rounds open on the classroom clock. The credits spent stay in the ledger.",
      "The three experts score the strategy and hearing. Your simulated outcome and remaining credits do not award automatic points."
    ].map(item => "<li>" + esc(item) + "</li>").join("") + "</ol>", true)}
    ${disclosure("Round deadlines and defaults", '<ul>' + [
      "A complete draft has an affordable selected option, an evidence or assumption note and a trade-off note.",
      "At the deadline the browser locks that draft. The free default applies if the draft is incomplete or unavailable.",
      "Defaults in order: Profile A, base dossier, mock preparation without an entry route, keep a reserve, keep the offer, hold outreach, defer.",
      "The market is assigned and the profile is fixed after R1. R5 can narrow the segment, use case or corridor within that profile."
    ].map(line => '<li>' + esc(line) + '</li>').join("") + "</ul>")}
    ${disclosure("Singapore comparison base", facts(SINGAPORE) + sourceLinks(["revolut", "transfers", "paynow", "mexico", "argentina", "indicators"]))}
    ${disclosure("CAGE and Uppsala", "<p>For each CAGE dimension, compare one Singapore fact with one market fact and identify the effect on your plan. Rank two differences. For Uppsala, link a first local relationship and learning activity to a larger commitment only when evidence justifies it.</p>" + sourceLinks(["cage", "uppsala"]))}
    ${disclosure("Published assessment · 70 written / 30 oral", facts(RUBRIC.map(([,name,weight,checks]) => [name + " · " + weight, checks.join(" · ")])) + "<p>" + esc(QUESTION) + "</p>")}
    ${disclosure("Seminar programme · Moscow time", '<ul class="pv-schedule">' + SCHEDULE.map(item =>
      "<li><strong>" + interval(scheduledRoom, item.from, item.to) +
      "</strong><span>" + esc(item.label) + "</span></li>").join("") + "</ul>")}`;
  ui.materials.showModal();
}

function recordPhase(now) {
  const record = view.record;
  if (record.mode === "live") return phaseAt(record.room, now);
  if (view.practiceReview) return {id: view.practiceReview, to: null, bulletinB: record.bulletinB};
  return {id: ROUNDS[record.history.length]?.id || "PREP", to: null, bulletinB: record.bulletinB};
}

function progressBar(phase, path) {
  return '<ol class="pv-progress" aria-label="Round progress">' +
    ROUNDS.map((round, index) => `<li${phase.id === round.id ? ' aria-current="step"' : ""} class="${index < path.length ? "pv-step-done" : ""}">
      <strong class="pv-mono">${round.id}</strong><span class="pv-step-name">${esc(round.short)}</span></li>`).join("") + "</ol>";
}

function marketDossier(market, selected) {
  const profiles = selected ? [[selected, market.profiles[selected]]] : Object.entries(market.profiles);
  return `<div class="pv-wording">
    ${facts(market.facts)}
    ${profiles.map(([id, profile]) => `<article class="pv-dossier"><p class="pv-mono">Profile ${id}</p>
      <h3>${esc(profile.name)}</h3><p>${esc(profile.journey)}</p><p><strong>Suggested channel</strong> · ${esc(profile.channel)}</p>
      <ul>${profile.alternatives.map(([name, detail, link]) => `<li><a href="${esc(link)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${esc(name)}</a> · ${esc(detail)}</li>`).join("")}</ul></article>`).join("")}
    ${sourceLinks(market.sources)}
  </div>`;
}

function worksheet(round, record, locked = false) {
  return '<div class="pv-fields">' + WORKSHEET[round.id].map(([field, label]) =>
    '<label class="pv-field">' + esc(label) + '<textarea maxlength="' + CONFIG.maxNote + '" ' +
    (locked ? 'readonly' : 'data-note data-round="' + round.id + '" data-field="' + field + '"') + '>' +
    esc(record.notes[round.id + "." + field]) + '</textarea></label>').join("") + "</div>";
}

function optionCard(option, selected, round) {
  return `<label class="pv-choice">
    <input type="radio" name="choice" value="${option.id}" data-draft="choice" data-round="${round.id}"
      ${option.blocked ? "disabled" : ""}${selected === option.id ? " checked" : ""}>
    <span class="pv-choice-card"><span class="pv-choice-top">
      <span class="pv-cost pv-mono">${option.cost} ${option.cost === 1 ? "credit" : "credits"}</span><span class="pv-radio-mark" aria-hidden="true"></span>
    </span><span class="pv-choice-title">${esc(option.label)}</span>
    <span class="pv-choice-text">${esc(option.description)}</span>
    ${option.blocked ? '<span class="pv-lock">' + esc(option.blocked) + "</span>" : ""}
    </span>
  </label>`;
}

function stageLabel(phase) {
  const round = ROUNDS.find(item => item.id === phase.id);
  if (round) return round.id + " · " + round.short;
  return SCHEDULE.find(item => item.id === phase.id)?.label ?? "Board Brief";
}

// The hidden game result, shown as progress: what is earned so far and the most that is still possible.
function meterHtml(record) {
  const progress = gameProgress(record);
  const earned = Math.round(progress.earned);
  const possible = Math.round(progress.possible);
  const summary = progress.final !== null ? "<strong>" + earned + "</strong> · final" : "<strong>" + earned + "</strong> earned · up to <strong>" + possible + "</strong>";
  return `<div class="pv-meter" data-meter><p class="pv-mono">Board confidence</p>
    <div class="pv-meter-bar" role="img" aria-label="${earned} points earned, up to ${possible} still possible">
      <span class="pv-meter-possible" style="width:${possible}%"></span><span class="pv-meter-earned" style="width:${earned}%"></span></div>
    <p class="pv-meter-text">${summary}</p></div>`;
}

// The bar that stays on screen while the page scrolls: table and market, stage and its timer, progress and credits.
function stickyBar(record, state, phase, path) {
  const market = MARKETS[record.market];
  return `<div class="pv-sticky" data-sticky><div class="pv-bar">
      <div class="pv-bar-id"><p class="pv-mono">Table ${record.team} · ${record.mode === "practice" ? "Practice" : esc(record.room)}</p>
        <h1 class="pv-board-title">${esc(market.name)}</h1><p class="pv-board-context">${esc(market.city)} · ${market.currency}</p></div>
      <div class="pv-bar-stage"><p class="pv-mono" data-stage-name>${esc(stageLabel(phase))}</p>
        <div class="pv-clock" data-clock hidden><span data-clock-label></span><strong data-clock-time></strong></div></div>
      ${meterHtml(record)}
      <div class="pv-budget" aria-label="${state.credits} of ${CONFIG.budget} credits left"><strong>${state.credits}</strong><span class="pv-mono">Credits<br>left</span>
        <small class="pv-credits-preview" data-credits-preview hidden></small></div>
    </div>${progressBar(phase, path)}</div>`;
}

function roundCard(round, state, record, phase) {
  const market = MARKETS[record.market];
  const dossier = round.id === "R1" ? disclosure("Singapore and assigned market facts", facts(SINGAPORE) + marketDossier(market, null), false) : "";
  const candidates = round.id === "R3" ? disclosure("Local candidate files · simulation", facts(Object.values(market.candidates)), false) : "";
  const incoming = pendingFact(round.id, state, record.market);
  const update = incoming ? '<div class="pv-event"><p class="pv-mono">New information</p><p>' + esc(incoming) + "</p></div>" : "";
  const emergency = round.id === "R6" ? `<div class="pv-event"><p class="pv-mono">Bulletin A · alert</p><p>${esc(BULLETINS.A)}</p></div>
    ${phase.bulletinB ? '<div class="pv-event"><p class="pv-mono">Bulletin B · verified facts</p><p>' + esc(BULLETINS.B) + '</p><p class="pv-block-gap">' + esc(market.profiles[state.profile].incident) + "</p></div>" :
      '<p class="pv-task">Bulletin B opens eight minutes into R6. The response choices unlock then.</p>'}` : "";
  return dossier + candidates + update + emergency + '<div class="pv-task"><strong>Team task</strong>' + esc(round.task) + '</div>';
}

function decisionForm(round, state, record) {
  const draft = record.drafts[round.id] || {};
  const options = optionsFor(round.id, state, record.market);
  const available = options.some(option => option.id === draft.choice && !option.blocked);
  const output = available ? "You have " + (state.credits - options.find(option => option.id === draft.choice).cost) + " credits after this choice." :
    "Select an action. Add evidence and a trade-off before you lock it.";
  return `<form data-form="lock" data-round="${round.id}">
    <fieldset class="pv-choices"><legend>Choose one action</legend>
      ${options.map(option => optionCard(option, draft.choice, round)).join("")}
    </fieldset>
    ${round.id === "R6" ? `<label class="pv-field pv-problem" data-problem${draft.choice === "targeted" ? "" : " hidden"}>Which problem does this correction address?
      <select class="pv-input" data-draft="problem" data-round="R6"><option value="">Select a problem…</option>${PROBLEMS.map(item =>
        `<option value="${item.id}"${draft.problem === item.id ? " selected" : ""}>${esc(item.label)}</option>`).join("")}</select></label>` : ""}
    <div class="pv-fields">
      <label class="pv-field">Evidence or assumption<textarea data-draft="evidence" data-round="${round.id}" maxlength="${CONFIG.maxNote}" required>${esc(draft.evidence)}</textarea></label>
      <label class="pv-field">Benefit and trade-off<textarea data-draft="tradeoff" data-round="${round.id}" maxlength="${CONFIG.maxNote}" required>${esc(draft.tradeoff)}</textarea></label>
    </div>
    <div class="pv-commit pv-commit--decision"><p data-choice-hint>${esc(output)}</p>
      <button type="submit" class="pv-button pv-button--primary"${available && isDraftComplete(draft, round.id) ? "" : " disabled"}>Lock this choice</button>
    </div></form>`;
}

function roundScreen(round, state, record, phase, lastEvent) {
  const title = round.title;
  const time = record.mode === "practice" ? "Practice" : interval(record.room, phase.from, phase.to);
  const label = round.id + " · " + time;
  if (lastEvent?.round === round.id) {
    const next = record.mode === "practice" ?
      button(round.id === "R7" ? "Prepare the Board Brief" : "Next round", "next-practice", "primary") :
      '<p>Continue preparing your worksheet. The next stage opens on the classroom clock.</p>';
    const note = lastEvent.method === "default" ? "Default recorded" : "Decision locked";
    return stage(title, label, `<div class="pv-record"><p class="pv-mono">${note}</p><h3>${esc(lastEvent.label)}</h3>
        <p>${esc(lastEvent.result)}</p><p>${lastEvent.cost} spent · ${lastEvent.credits} remaining</p></div>
      ${record.mode === "live" ? '<div class="pv-panel pv-checkpoint"><strong>' + (round.id === "R4" ? "Save your checkpoint before the break." : "Save a backup copy.") + "</strong>" + backupLine(record) + syncLine(record) +
        '<div class="pv-file-actions">' + button("Download backup JSON", "export-json") + "</div></div>" : ""}
      ${disclosure("Team worksheet", worksheet(round, record), true)}
      <div class="pv-commit">${next}</div>`, "review");
  }

  const beforeBulletin = round.id === "R6" && !phase.bulletinB;
  return stage(title, label, roundCard(round, state, record, phase) +
    (beforeBulletin ? disclosure("Team worksheet", worksheet(round, record), true) +
      (record.mode === "practice" ? '<div class="pv-commit">' + button("Reveal bulletin B", "practice-b", "primary") + "</div>" : "") :
      decisionForm(round, state, record) + disclosure("Team worksheet", worksheet(round, record), true) +
      (record.mode === "practice" ? '<div class="pv-file-actions">' + button("Try this round’s default", "practice-default", "text") + "</div>" : "")),
    round.id === "R6" ? "event" : "");
}

function logList(path, detailed = false, record = null) {
  if (!path.length) return '<p class="pv-inline-note">Decisions appear after they are locked.</p>';
  return '<ol class="pv-log">' + path.map(event =>
    '<li><span class="pv-mono">' + event.round + '</span> <strong>' + esc(event.label) + '</strong><p>' +
    event.cost + " spent · " + event.credits + " left" + (event.method === "default" ? " · default" : "") + "</p>" +
    (detailed ? "<p>" + esc(event.result) + "</p>" +
      (event.evidence ? '<p class="pv-journal-notes"><strong>Evidence</strong> · ' + esc(event.evidence) + "</p>" : "") +
      (event.tradeoff ? '<p class="pv-journal-notes"><strong>Trade-off</strong> · ' + esc(event.tradeoff) + "</p>" : "") +
      (record ? disclosure("Worksheet for " + event.round, worksheet(ROUNDS.find(round => round.id === event.round), record, true)) : "") : "") + "</li>").join("") + "</ol>";
}

function gameResult(record) {
  const result = gameScore(record);
  const share = Math.round(tuning().gameShare * 100);
  return '<div class="pv-record pv-game-result"><p class="pv-mono">Your game result</p><h3>' + Math.round(result.total) + " / 100</h3>" +
    '<table class="pv-breakdown"><tbody>' + result.parts.map(part => "<tr><td>" + esc(part.label) + "</td><td>" + Math.round(part.points) + "</td></tr>").join("") + "</tbody></table>" +
    "<p>The game result counts for " + share + "% of your final grade; the expert panel decides the other " + (100 - share) + "%. The Chair announces the final decision.</p></div>";
}

function resultScreen(phase, state, path, record) {
  const last = path.at(-1);
  const outcome = OUTCOMES[last.choice];
  const editing = phase.id === "PREP";
  return stage("Board Brief", record.mode === "practice" ? "Practice outcome" : "Investment hearing", `
    <div class="pv-record pv-checkpoint"><p class="pv-mono">Your recommendation</p><h3>${esc(outcome[0])}</h3><p>${esc(outcome[1])}</p></div>
    ${gameResult(record)}
    <div class="pv-task"><strong>At the hearing</strong>Three minutes to pitch and one minute for the common question. Show the first customer, two CAGE findings, the Uppsala pathway, what the budget changed and how you handled the emergency.</div>
    <p><strong>Common question</strong> · ${esc(QUESTION)}</p>
    <label class="pv-field pv-block-gap">One-page Board Brief
      <textarea rows="10" maxlength="${CONFIG.maxNote * 3}"${editing ? ' data-brief' : ' readonly'}
      placeholder="Market and funding ask · Customer and competing offer · CAGE and entry milestones · Budget trade-off · Emergency and launch condition">${esc(record.brief)}</textarea>
    </label>
    <div class="pv-file-actions pv-actions">${button("Download Board Brief", "export-board")}${button("Download team JSON", "export-json")}</div>
    ${disclosure("Review the full decision journal", logList(path, true, record))}
    <p class="pv-inline-note pv-block-gap">${CONFIG.budget - state.credits} spent · ${state.credits} left. The expert panel evaluates the strategy and the pitch.</p>`, "final");
}

function waitingScreen(phase, record) {
  const pauses = {
    SETUP: ["The Board is opening the session", "R1 opens with the classroom clock. Read the rules and the Chair’s brief while you wait."],
    BREAK: ["Seminar break", "R5 opens when the second seminar begins. Save the team JSON before moving to another device."]
  };
  const [title, info] = pauses[phase.id] || ["Waiting for the next stage", "Follow the facilitator’s instructions."];
  return stage(title, MARKETS[record.market].name, '<p>' + esc(info) + "</p>" +
    '<div class="pv-file-actions">' + button("Download team JSON", "export-json") + "</div>", "review");
}

function renderTeam(now) {
  const record = view.record;
  const market = MARKETS[record.market];
  const {state, path} = replay(record);
  const phase = recordPhase(now);
  const round = ROUNDS.find(item => item.id === phase.id);
  const body = round ? roundScreen(round, state, record, phase, path.at(-1)) :
    path.length === ROUNDS.length ? resultScreen(phase, state, path, record) : waitingScreen(phase, record);
  return `${stickyBar(record, state, phase, path)}
    <div class="pv-layout"><div>${body}</div><aside class="pv-sidebar">
      <section class="pv-sidebar-card"><h3>Decision journal</h3>${logList(path)}
        <div class="pv-file-actions pv-actions">${button("Journal TXT", "export-txt")}${button("Save JSON", "export-json")}</div>
        ${backupLine(record)}${syncLine(record)}
      </section>
      <section class="pv-sidebar-card"><h3>Team materials</h3>
        ${disclosure("Market dossier", marketDossier(market, state.profile))}
        ${disclosure("Singapore comparison base", facts(SINGAPORE) + sourceLinks(["paynow", "revolut", "transfers"]))}
        ${path.length ? disclosure("Earlier evidence and notes", logList(path, true, record)) : ""}
        ${record.mode === "practice" ? '<div class="pv-file-actions">' + button("Reset practice", "reset", "text") + "</div>" : ""}
      </section>
    </aside></div>`;
}

function updateClock(now = trueNow()) {
  if (view.page === "host") {
    hostClock(root, now);
    return;
  }
  const clock = root.querySelector("[data-clock]");
  if (!clock || view.record?.mode !== "live") return;
  const phase = recordPhase(now);
  if (phase.to === null) return;
  const limit = (phase.id === "R6" && !phase.bulletinB ? 92 : phase.to);
  const delta = roomStart(view.record.room) + limit * 60_000 - now;
  clock.hidden = false;
  clock.dataset.near = delta <= 120_000;
  clock.querySelector("[data-clock-label]").textContent = phase.id === "R6" && !phase.bulletinB ? "Bulletin B in" : phase.id === "SETUP" || phase.id === "BREAK" ? "Next round in" : "Time left";
  clock.querySelector("[data-clock-time]").textContent = countdown(delta);
}

function render(focus = "") {
  const now = trueNow();
  const element = document.activeElement;
  const field = element?.dataset;
  const selection = [element?.selectionStart, element?.selectionEnd];
  ui.home.hidden = view.page === "home";
  ui.screen.innerHTML = view.page === "team" ? renderTeam(now) : view.page === "host" ? renderHost(now) : view.page === "recover" ? recoveryScreen() : homeScreen();
  view.pageKey = view.page === "team" ? teamKeyForView(now) : "";
  renderNotice();
  updateClock(now);
  if (focus) {
    const target = root.querySelector(focus);
    target?.focus({preventScroll: true});
    target?.scrollIntoView({block: "start", behavior: "instant"});
  } else if (field?.note !== undefined && selection[0] != null) {
    const target = [...root.querySelectorAll("textarea[data-note]")].find(item => item.dataset.round === field.round && item.dataset.field === field.field);
    target?.focus({preventScroll: true});
    target?.setSelectionRange(...selection);
  }
}

function recoveryScreen() {
  const {message, options, room, team} = view.recovery;
  const list = options.length ? '<ul class="pv-recovery">' + options.map((option, index) =>
    "<li><strong>" + esc(option.source) + "</strong> · " + MARKETS[option.record.market].name + " · " +
    (option.rounds ? "decisions locked through " + ROUNDS[option.rounds - 1].id : "no decisions locked yet") + " " +
    button("Restore this copy", "recover-pick", "", 'data-index="' + index + '"') + "</li>").join("") + "</ul>" :
    "<p>No readable copy was found in this browser.</p>";
  return stage("This saved game could not be opened", "Table " + team + " · " + (room === "PRACTICE" ? "Practice" : room),
    "<p>" + esc(message) + "</p><p>Restore the newest readable copy below, or the JSON file you downloaded. The damaged save stays untouched until you choose.</p>" + list +
    '<div class="pv-file-actions pv-actions">' + button("Restore JSON", "import", "primary", 'data-purpose="team"') + button("Back to home", "home") + "</div>", "event");
}

async function showRecovery(error) {
  const options = await recoveryOptions(error.room, error.team);
  view.page = "recover";
  view.record = null;
  view.practiceReview = null;
  view.recovery = {message: error.message, options, room: error.room, team: error.team};
  announce("");
  render("#omf-stage-title");
}

function fail(error) {
  if (error instanceof SaveError) void showRecovery(error);
  else announce(error.message || "The action could not be completed.", "warning");
}

// How current the downloaded backup is, in words and as a state for colouring.
function backupSummary(record) {
  const backup = readBackup(record.room, record.team);
  const decisions = record.history.length;
  const behind = backupBehind(decisions, backup);
  const state = behind === 0 ? "ok" : behind === 1 ? "warn" : "late";
  const minutes = backup ? Math.max(0, Math.round((trueNow() - backup.at) / 60_000)) : 0;
  const last = backup ? (backup.rounds ? ROUNDS[backup.rounds - 1].id : "setup") + ", " + (minutes < 1 ? "just now" : minutes + " min ago") : "";
  const saved = !decisions ? "Nothing to back up yet." :
    !backup ? "No backup file yet: " + decisions + (decisions === 1 ? " decision exists" : " decisions exist") + " only in this browser." :
    behind ? "The backup is " + behind + (behind === 1 ? " decision" : " decisions") + " behind (last: after " + last + ")." :
    "The backup is current (after " + last + ").";
  const protection = {granted: " Browser storage is protected.", denied: " The browser may clear this page’s data, so keep the JSON file."}[persistenceState()] || "";
  return {state, text: saved + protection};
}

function backupLine(record) {
  if (record.mode !== "live") return "";
  const {state, text} = backupSummary(record);
  return '<p class="pv-backup" data-backup-state="' + state + '"><span data-backup-text>' + esc(text) + "</span></p>";
}

function refreshBackup() {
  if (view.page !== "team" || !view.record || view.record.mode !== "live") return;
  const {state, text} = backupSummary(view.record);
  for (const element of root.querySelectorAll("[data-backup-state]")) {
    element.dataset.backupState = state;
    element.querySelector("[data-backup-text]").textContent = text;
  }
}

function syncLine(record) {
  const summary = record.mode === "live" ? syncSummary() : null;
  if (!summary) return "";
  return '<p class="pv-backup pv-sync" data-sync-state="' + summary.state + '"><span data-sync-text>' + esc(summary.text) + "</span> " +
    button("Send again", "sync-now", "text") + "</p>";
}

function refreshSync() {
  const summary = syncSummary();
  if (!summary) return;
  for (const element of root.querySelectorAll("[data-sync-state]")) {
    element.dataset.syncState = summary.state;
    element.querySelector("[data-sync-text]").textContent = summary.text;
  }
}

function triggerSync(force = false) {
  if (view.page !== "team" || !view.record) return Promise.resolve();
  const job = flushSync(view.record, {force});
  refreshSync();
  return job.then(refreshSync, refreshSync);
}

function teamKeyForView(now) {
  const phase = recordPhase(now);
  return phase.id + ":" + Number(phase.bulletinB) + ":" + view.record.history.length;
}

function ask(title, message, action) {
  ui["confirm-title"].textContent = title;
  ui["confirm-text"].textContent = message;
  ui["confirm-yes"].textContent = action;
  ui.confirm.returnValue = "cancel";
  return new Promise(resolve => {
    ui.confirm.addEventListener("close", () => resolve(ui.confirm.returnValue === "confirm"), {once: true});
    ui.confirm.showModal();
  });
}

function showTeam(record, message = "") {
  view.page = "team";
  view.record = record;
  view.practiceReview = null;
  view.team = record.team;
  activeTeam({room: record.room, team: record.team});
  const stale = contentMismatch(record) ? " This save was made with a different version of the game content, so the text and results shown here may differ from what the team saw." : "";
  announce((message + stale).trim(), stale ? "warning" : "info");
  render("#omf-stage-title");
  void requestPersistence().then(refreshBackup);
  void triggerSync();
}

async function join() {
  const room = view.entryMode === "live" ? view.room.trim().toUpperCase() : "PRACTICE";
  if (view.entryMode === "live" && roomStart(room) === null) throw new Error("Enter the room code shown by the facilitator.");
  const market = view.entryMode === "live" ? marketForTable(room, view.team) : view.market;
  let record;
  try {
    record = await withSaveLock(teamKey(room, view.team), () => {
      let record = readSlot(room, view.team);
      if (record && record.market !== market) throw new Error("This practice table has a saved market. Open it and reset practice, or choose another table.");
      record = record || newRecord(view.entryMode, room, view.team, market);
      record = settleDeadlines(record, trueNow());
      storeRecord(record);
      return record;
    });
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof SaveError) return showRecovery(error);
    throw error;
  }
  showTeam(record);
}

function saveChange(change, now = trueNow()) {
  const expected = view.record;
  if (!expected) return Promise.resolve();
  const job = view.writes.then(() => withSaveLock(teamKey(expected.room, expected.team), () => {
    const current = readSlot(expected.room, expected.team);
    if (!current || current.session !== expected.session) throw new Error("The saved team session has changed. Reopen it from Home.");
    const settled = settleDeadlines(current, now);
    if (settled !== current) storeRecord(settled);
    const next = change(settled, now);
    if (next !== settled) storeRecord(next);
    if (view.record?.session === expected.session) view.record = next;
    if (next.history.length !== current.history.length) setTimeout(() => void triggerSync(), 0);
    return next;
  }));
  view.writes = job.catch(() => {});
  return job;
}

function updateChoiceHint() {
  const form = root.querySelector('form[data-form="lock"]');
  if (!form || !view.record) return;
  const id = form.dataset.round;
  const draft = view.record.drafts[id];
  const {state} = replay(view.record);
  const item = optionsFor(id, state, view.record.market).find(item => item.id === draft?.choice && !item.blocked);
  form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]').disabled = !item || !isDraftComplete(draft, id);
  form.querySelector("[data-choice-hint]").textContent = item ? "You have " + (state.credits - item.cost) + " credits after this choice." :
    "Select an action. Add evidence and a trade-off before you lock it.";
  const problem = form.querySelector("[data-problem]");
  if (problem) problem.hidden = draft?.choice !== "targeted";
  // Preview the spend in the bar that stays on screen.
  const preview = root.querySelector("[data-credits-preview]");
  if (preview) {
    preview.hidden = !item || item.cost === 0;
    if (item) preview.textContent = state.credits + " → " + (state.credits - item.cost);
  }
}

function capture(element) {
  if (view.page !== "team") return;
  const {draft, note, round, field, brief} = element.dataset;
  const value = element.value;
  let change;
  if (draft) change = (record, now) => updateDraft(record, round, draft, value, now);
  else if (note !== undefined) change = (record, now) => updateNote(record, round, field, value, now);
  else if (brief !== undefined) change = (record, now) => updateBrief(record, value, now);
  if (change) void saveChange(change).then(updateChoiceHint).catch(fail);
}

async function submitRound(round, useDefault = false) {
  const open = view.record;
  if (open?.mode === "live" && !useDefault) {
    const phase = phaseAt(open.room, trueNow());
    const left = phase.to === null ? 0 : roomStart(open.room) + phase.to * 60_000 - trueNow();
    if (left > 10_000 && !await ask("Lock this decision?", "A locked decision is final: you cannot change it afterwards. " + countdown(left) +
        " is still left in this stage. Your worksheet notes stay editable until the stage closes.", "Lock decision")) return;
  }
  const record = await saveChange((current, now) => lockRound(current, round, now, useDefault));
  if (!record) return;
  if (record.mode === "practice") view.practiceReview = round;
  announce("");
  render("#omf-stage-title");
}

async function restoreTeam(file) {
  if (file.size > CONFIG.maxImportBytes) throw new Error("The JSON file is too large.");
  let parsed;
  try { parsed = JSON.parse(await file.text()); }
  catch { throw new Error("Choose a JSON file exported by the game."); }
  await restoreRecord(validateRecord(parsed), "Game restored from JSON.");
}

async function restoreRecord(record, message, confirm = true) {
  const key = teamKey(record.room, record.team);
  await view.writes;
  const before = getStored(key);
  if (confirm && before !== null && !await ask("Replace a saved game?", "Restore table " + record.team + " for " + MARKETS[record.market].name + " from this JSON file?", "Restore")) return;
  const next = await withSaveLock(key, () => {
    if (getStored(key) !== before) throw new Error("The save changed. Pick the file again.");
    const restored = settleDeadlines({...record, session: newId()}, trueNow());
    storeRecord(restored);
    return restored;
  });
  showTeam(next, message);
}

async function download(format) {
  await saveChange(record => record);
  const record = view.record;
  if (!record) return;
  if (format === "json") {
    saveFile(teamFilename(record, "json", "save"), JSON.stringify(record, null, 2), "application/json");
    markBackup(record.room, record.team, record.history.length, trueNow());
    refreshBackup();
  } else saveFile(teamFilename(record, "txt", format === "board" ? "board-brief" : "journal"), textReport(record, format === "board"), "text/plain;charset=utf-8");
}

function home() {
  if (view.record) {
    view.entryMode = view.record.mode;
    if (view.record.mode === "live") view.room = view.record.room;
    else view.market = view.record.market;
  }
  view.page = "home";
  view.record = null;
  view.recovery = null;
  view.practiceReview = null;
  activeTeam(null);
  announce("");
  render("#omf-entry-title");
}

async function run(action) {
  if (view.busy) return;
  view.busy = true;
  try { await action(); }
  catch (error) { fail(error); }
  finally { view.busy = false; }
}

const controls = {
  home: async () => { await view.writes; home(); },
  host: async () => { await view.writes; view.page = "host"; view.record = null; activeTeam(null); announce(""); render("#omf-stage-title"); },
  materials: renderMaterials,
  "close-materials": () => ui.materials.close(),
  "jump-entry": () => {
    const heading = root.querySelector("#omf-entry-title");
    heading.focus({preventScroll: true});
    heading.scrollIntoView({block: "start", behavior: "instant"});
  },
  "entry-mode": () => { view.entryMode = view.entryMode === "live" ? "practice" : "live"; render("#omf-entry-title"); },
  import: target => { view.readingFor = target.dataset.purpose; ui.file.click(); },
  "practice-b": async () => {
    await saveChange(record => ({...record, bulletinB: true}));
    render("#omf-stage-title");
  },
  "practice-default": () => submitRound(ROUNDS[view.record.history.length].id, true),
  "sync-now": () => triggerSync(true),
  "recover-pick": target => {
    const option = view.recovery?.options[Number(target.dataset.index)];
    if (option) return restoreRecord(option.record, "Restored the " + option.source + ".", false);
  },
  "next-practice": () => { view.practiceReview = null; render("#omf-stage-title"); },
  "export-json": () => download("json"),
  "export-txt": () => download("txt"),
  "export-board": () => download("board"),
  reset: async () => {
    const record = view.record;
    if (record?.mode !== "practice" || !await ask("Reset the practice table?", "Its locally saved choices and notes will be removed.", "Reset practice")) return;
    await view.writes;
    await withSaveLock(teamKey(record.room, record.team), () => {
      if (readSlot(record.room, record.team)?.session !== record.session) throw new Error("The practice save has changed.");
      clearSlot(record.room, record.team);
    });
    home();
  }
};

root.addEventListener("click", event => {
  const target = event.target.closest("button[data-action]");
  if (!target || target.disabled) return;
  const id = target.dataset.action;
  if (Object.hasOwn(controls, id)) void run(() => controls[id](target));
  else if (view.page === "host" && id.startsWith("host-")) void run(() => handleHostAction(id, target, {render, announce, ask}));
});

root.addEventListener("submit", event => {
  const form = event.target;
  if (form.dataset.form === "join") { event.preventDefault(); void run(join); }
  else if (form.dataset.form === "lock") {
    event.preventDefault();
    void run(() => submitRound(form.dataset.round));
  }
});

root.addEventListener("input", event => {
  const input = event.target;
  if (input.dataset.entry === "room") {
    view.room = input.value;
    refreshAssignment();
  } else if (input.matches("textarea")) capture(input);
  if (input.dataset.host) updateHostField(input);
});

function refreshAssignment() {
  const info = root.querySelector("[data-assigned]");
  const market = MARKETS[marketForTable(view.room, view.team)];
  if (info && view.entryMode === "live") info.textContent = market && roomStart(view.room) !== null ? "Your assigned market is " + market.name + "." : "Use the table number assigned by the facilitator.";
}

root.addEventListener("change", event => {
  const input = event.target;
  if (input.dataset.entry === "team") { view.team = Number(input.value); refreshAssignment(); }
  else if (input.dataset.entry === "market") view.market = input.value;
  else if (input.dataset.draft === "choice" || input.dataset.draft === "problem") capture(input);
  else if (input === ui.file) {
    const file = input.files[0];
    input.value = "";
    if (file) void run(() => view.readingFor === "host" ? importTeamFile(file, {render, announce, ask}) : restoreTeam(file));
  } else if (input.dataset.host) updateHostField(input, render);
});

async function syncTeam() {
  if (view.page !== "team" || !view.record || view.busy) return;
  const now = trueNow();
  if (view.record.mode === "live" && teamKeyForView(now) !== view.pageKey) {
    await run(async () => { await saveChange(record => record, now); render(); });
  }
  updateClock(now);
}

window.addEventListener("storage", event => {
  if (view.page !== "team" || view.busy || event.key !== teamKey(view.record.room, view.record.team)) return;
  void run(async () => {
    const current = readSlot(view.record.room, view.record.team);
    if (!current) { home(); return; }
    if (current.history.length !== view.record.history.length || current.session !== view.record.session) {
      view.record = current;
      view.practiceReview = null;
      announce("The team save was updated in another tab.");
      render();
    }
  });
});

let previousHostTick = 0;
setInterval(() => void triggerSync(), 30_000);
window.addEventListener("online", () => void triggerSync());

let previousBackupTick = 0;
setInterval(() => {
  if (view.page === "team") {
    void syncTeam();
    const now = trueNow();
    if (now - previousBackupTick > 15_000) { refreshBackup(); previousBackupTick = now; }
  }
  if (view.page === "host") {
    const now = trueNow();
    if (now - previousHostTick > 350) { updateClock(now); previousHostTick = now; }
  }
}, 300);

// Settle deadlines only after the shared clock is known: an early default is written permanently.
const syncing = syncClock().catch(() => {});
await Promise.race([syncing, new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 3000))]);
void syncing.then(() => renderNotice());
setInterval(() => void syncClock().then(() => renderNotice(), () => {}), 10 * 60_000);

const last = activeTeam();
if (knownTable(last)) {
  view.room = last.room === "PRACTICE" ? "" : last.room;
  view.entryMode = last.room === "PRACTICE" ? "practice" : "live";
  view.team = last.team;
  try {
    const record = readSlot(last.room, last.team);
    if (record) {
      view.page = "team";
      view.record = record;
      await saveChange(current => current);
    }
  } catch (error) {
    view.page = "home";
    view.record = null;
    if (error instanceof SaveError) await showRecovery(error);
    else announce(error.message, "warning");
  }
}
render();
void triggerSync();
})();
})();
</script>
<!-- End T123 -->
